### Phase 21: remove unused scratch allocation from completed cover scoring

`active` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase21-cover-complete-scratch/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Avoid allocating per-region ForwardScratch buffers when the parallel cover scorer reads a completed immutable candidate cache. The lazy hierarchical path must retain its reusable transform buffers; only the completed-cache path may use zero-capacity scratch because CoverForwardBank::Complete never performs a forward transform. Retain only if canonical streams and decoder behavior remain unchanged and a pinned comparison shows neutral or improved target-rate speed.
